description: Every Taifoon operation on one board, priced IN (what the worker receives) and OUT (what the consumer pays) in GRID at the oracle's published peg: Grid kinds at the live rate, the Taifoon chains' RPC, MMR twigs and proofs, AI calls, hosting classes, the bridge fee, x402 skills, coordination and agents (n8n instances).
